home.heroBadge: Engineered in Compliance with IEC 61508 & ISO 9001:2015
home.heroTitle: Precision Process Control & Industrial Automation Engineering
home.heroSubtitle: Arya Sanat Precision Dynamics engineers and manufactures mission-critical control valves, process instrumentation, Edge SCADA controllers, and smart power switchgear for vital industries.
home.introTitle: Uniting Metallurgy, Industrial Electronics & Intelligent Control at International Scale
home.introText1: Arya Sanat Precision Dynamics delivers integrated measurement, fluid regulation, and process automation architectures built to withstand the most demanding pressure, thermal, and corrosive industrial environments.
home.introText2: From our ISO/IEC 17025 accredited metrology rigs to 5-axis CNC machining halls and cleanroom electronics assembly lines, every serial-numbered unit undergoes rigorous hydro-pneumatic and EMC validation before dispatch.
home.introBullet1: Modular architecture engineered to adapt to site-specific P&ID and climatic profiles
home.introBullet2: Native multi-protocol interoperability across HART 7, Modbus TCP, Profinet, and OPC-UA
home.introBullet3: Guaranteed long-term spare parts continuity, full CAD packages, and lifecycle field engineering
home.featuredSubtitle: Selected industrial hardware engineered for high-pressure process lines, utility power plants, and smart factories.
home.categoriesTitle: Four Core Pillars of Manufacturing Technology
home.categoriesSubtitle: Our hardware ecosystem spans every critical layer from field instrumentation to central control rooms.
home.capabilitiesTitle: End-to-End Engineering from CFD Simulation to Accredited Validation
home.cap1Desc: Computational fluid dynamics and thermal-stress modeling eliminate cavitation and acoustic vibration prior to prototyping.
home.cap2Desc: Micron-tolerance machining of Super Duplex stainless steel, Inconel, Hastelloy, and Titanium grades.
home.cap3Desc: Equipped with gravimetric mass-flow loops, 400-bar hydrostatic benches, and environmental thermal chambers.
home.cap4Desc: Automated SMT production of ruggedized multi-layer control boards shielded against high-voltage substation interference.
home.whyTitle: Why Leading Industrial Operators Partner With Arya Sanat
home.why1Desc: Hot-standby redundancy and industrial-grade components safeguard continuous plant uptime without unplanned shutdowns.
home.why2Desc: Delivered with 3D STEP models, ISA-compliant datasheets, and serialized factory acceptance test (FAT) certificates.
home.why3Title: Bespoke Sizing Tailored to Project P&IDs
home.why3Desc: Custom Cv trim calculation, wetted alloy selection, and bus protocol mapping aligned to exact process conditions.
home.why4Title: Direct Lifecycle Support from Design Engineers
home.why4Desc: Plant commissioning and maintenance teams collaborate directly with our core R&D and application engineers.
home.projectsSubtitle: Real-world operational performance of Arya Sanat systems across critical infrastructure.
home.industriesSubtitle: Our equipment is certified and optimized for the stringent regulatory demands of each vertical.
home.certsSubtitle: Our commitment to functional safety and quality management is verified through continuous third-party audits.

about.title: Precision Engineering for Tomorrow's Resilient Infrastructure
about.subtitle: Over 27 years of sustained innovation in designing, manufacturing, and validating industrial fluid control, process metrology, and smart automation hardware.
about.historyP1: Founded in 1998 by a consortium of mechanical, control systems, and instrumentation engineers, Arya Sanat Precision Dynamics set out to bridge advanced theoretical metrology with rugged heavy-industry manufacturing.
about.historyP2: Today, operating across a 24,000-square-meter integrated R&D, CNC manufacturing, and ISO 17025 calibration campus, our equipment regulates critical flows and power distribution across hundreds of utility, desalination, petrochemical, and pharmaceutical plants.
about.missionText: To elevate industrial process safety, energy efficiency, and operational uptime by engineering world-class precision instrumentation and control systems backed by transparent documentation and responsive field support.
about.visionText: To stand as a premier international benchmark in IIoT-ready digital process instrumentation and sustainable fluid control engineering across regional and global industrial corridors.
about.val1Desc: In process instrumentation, hundredths of a percent define the boundary between optimal yield and operational hazard.
about.val2Desc: Every published specification is backed by traceable laboratory test protocols and serialized calibration records.
about.val3Desc: Engineering low-fugitive-emission packing and high-efficiency drives to minimize industrial carbon footprints.
about.val4Desc: Commissioning marks the beginning of a multi-decade engineering partnership throughout the asset's operational life.
about.timelineTitle: Key Chapters in Our Engineering Journey
about.teamSubtitle: Guided by veteran industrial architects, PhD researchers, and quality systems specialists.
